verdict: Afterglow is held with real discipline: one ground, one typeface, ember only as light and the fluff squiggle, a wordmark with an ownable hooked h, and the squiggle working as a brand device from hero to final headline to the footer sign-off. No P0 or P1 is open; what keeps it a hair under 9.5 is a small cluster of P2s in the main product card at 1440 (title scale and a dead band) and the one brand character, heycape, reading muddy at avatar size.
to_95: At 1440 give the Sharpen card title (#sh-h, 30px) the same 40px scale as the other 'big' bento titles (#vo-h, #day-h, #st-h): the main product moment currently has the smaller headline.
Close the empty band under 'Start free' in the Sharpen card at 1440 (about 80px of void after a result) by aligning the card's content to the neighbour's height or letting the result row fill it.
Lift the heycape avatar: it is dark artwork on a dark disc on a black post card, so the brand's one character disappears at 32-40px. Add a slightly lighter disc behind it or a tighter face crop.
Fill or tighten the FAQ left column at 1440: about 170px of nothing sits between the headline and the 'Short answers' note.

issues.problem: Computed 30px while the other 'cap big' titles (#vo-h, #day-h, #st-h) are 40px, so the hero product card carries a smaller headline than the supporting cards beneath it. At 390 they match (25.7px).
issues.fix: Set #sh-h to the 40px/41.6px big-caption size at >=1280 so every 'big' card title shares one size.

issues.where: Sharpen card at 1440, below the 'Start free' / 'Keep it. Start free' pill
issues.problem: Roughly 80px of empty panel sits under the CTA because the card is stretched to match the taller preview card beside it; it reads as unfinished in the most important card.
issues.fix: Distribute the height: let the editor box grow (min-height) or vertically space the result row so the CTA sits on the card's bottom padding.

issues.where: heycape avatar everywhere (hero draft, post cards, voice card, phone)
issues.problem: The illustrated avatar is dark-toned on a near-black disc on a black card, so at 32-40px it is a smudge while the photo avatars (Priya, Ana, Theo) read clearly. The brand's lead character has the least presence.
issues.fix: Put a lighter neutral disc (about #2A2D31) behind it or use a tighter crop on the face and glasses; keep the 1px hairline ring.

issues.problem: About 170px of empty space between the two-line headline and the 'Short answers to what people ask first' note; the column feels abandoned next to six tight rows.
issues.fix: Move the note directly under the headline (24px gap) or bottom-align both columns with a shorter list gap so the void closes.

issues.where: 'Say it at 11 PM' card at 390 on first entry
issues.problem: While the three steps stage in one by one, the card shows about 230px of blurred photo with nothing on it; a fast scroller sees an empty dark block.
issues.fix: Reserve less height up front (show all three step shells at reduced opacity and animate their content in) or shorten the stagger to under 600ms total.
